mapper.update: update coupon_template set remain_count = remain_count - 1 where id = #{id} and remain_count > 0
mapper.select: select mc.member_id, mc.template_id, mc.status, mc.verification_code, mc.receive_time, mc.use_time, ct.* from member_coupon mc inner join coupon_template ct on mc.template_id = ct.id where mc.member_id = #{memberId}
